article.title: Orlando faces Golden State on 3-game slide
article.linkText: Orlando faces Golden State on 3-game slide
article.story: Orlando Magic (2-6, 12th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (6-3, seventh in the Western Conference) San Francisco; Saturday, 8:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Orlando heads into the matchup against Golden State as losers of three games in a row. Golden State finished 37-45 overall a season ago while going 22-19 at home. The Warriors averaged 28.9 assists per game on 40.9 made field goals last season. Orlando went 45-37 overall with a 19-21 record on the road last season. The Magic gave up 115.1 points per game while committing 21.0 fouls last season. INJURIES: Warriors: Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee), Gui Santos: out (knee). Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: out (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
